dedupe_keys.name: grundachkataster nrw green roof retrofit potential for every roof surface in north rhine westphalia

description: The Gründachkataster NRW is a state-wide cadastre of the potential to retrofit green roofs on buildings in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. The state environment agency LANUV produced it for the Klimaatlas NRW by analysing more than 50 million roof parts on about 11.3 million buildings, using slope and orientation from the open digital surface model and the official open building outlines; the method paper is dated 28 March 2026. Coverage is the whole state. For each suitable roof part and a chosen substrate depth of 10, 20 or 30 cm it gives weight when saturated, retention in heavy rain, annual rainfall retention, evaporative cooling, savings on rainwater fees, carbon and fine dust binding, and approximate costs, with links to the state solar cadastre. Format and access: File Geodatabase downloads by administrative district and municipality from OpenGeodata.NRW, plus the Klimaatlas map. Licence: state open data; the dataset licence text was not read; free. Caveats: roof condition and structural capacity are not assessed. It supplies building-level green roof potential for heat and stormwater adaptation planning. Related catalogue records are Roofpedia and Modified-Roofpedia.
